ollie-gordon-ii.subject: Ollie Gordon II
ollie-gordon-ii.note: One good-looking first-team carry, with no baseline and no repeated involvement, does not establish a fantasy-relevant role change.
ollie-gordon-ii.evidence: There were two good-looking runs by the first-team offense on this day, one by De'Von Achane and the other by Ollie Gordon II.

devonta-smith.subject: DeVonta Smith
devonta-smith.reporter_found: DeVonta Smith returned to practice in a limited capacity Thursday. The Eagles listed him as limited with a hamstring injury. A day earlier, he participated in individual drills but did not take part in 11-on-11 work.
devonta-smith.edited_text: Smith's return is a positive step for his availability, but limited practice work does not establish that he is ready for full team periods or game action. No timetable was reported, so this does not change his projection.
devonta-smith.corroboration_note: One independent reporter, not two: both PhillyVoice spans are Jimmy Kempski. The hamstring designation comes from the club's own participation report, which is authoritative for its own designation and is never independent corroboration of the practice observation. Repeated participation-report language is linked to one underlying report rather than counted as separate confirmation.

sam-laporta.subject: Sam LaPorta
sam-laporta.reporter_found: Sam LaPorta did not participate in practice. The report did not provide a reason for his absence.
sam-laporta.edited_text: LaPorta's absence is worth noting, but one unexplained missed practice does not establish an injury or a continuing availability concern. No timetable or additional context was reported, so this does not change his projection.
sam-laporta.note: Reviewer-approved wording, applied verbatim. Not INJURY; not Trending down without a health issue or repeated absence.

makai-lemon.subject: Makai Lemon
makai-lemon.reporter_found: The Eagles officially listed Makai Lemon as a non-participant with a hamstring injury. Although he was not in uniform, he was observed taking part in some receiver drills.
makai-lemon.edited_text: Lemon's non-participant designation is a negative availability signal, although his receiver-drill work shows that he was not completely inactive. The evidence does not establish when he will resume full practice work, so this does not change his projection.
makai-lemon.corroboration_note: The club designation and the reporter's observation are different claims and are kept apart: the club is authoritative that he was a non-participant, the reporter saw him in receiver drills. LIMITED_PARTICIPATION describes the two together, not the club designation alone.
must_not_say: a limited participant in the official report

mack-hollins.subject: Mack Hollins
mack-hollins.reporter_found: Mack Hollins has regularly run routes and contributed during two-minute drills throughout Patriots training camp, regardless of which offensive unit was on the field.
mack-hollins.edited_text: Hollins' recurring participation in two-minute drills is a situational role worth tracking. However, the report includes work across multiple offensive units and does not establish first-team usage, target volume or a defined regular-season role. This does not change his projection.

projection_action.reason: A low-strength camp observation without first-team attribution, targets or snap volume does not justify projection review.

direction.reason: The evidence establishes repeated situational participation, not movement up the depth chart.

983c909d95fe01e076ee.subject: Terrace Marshall Jr.
983c909d95fe01e076ee.note: One catch from a backup quarterback during a joint practice does not establish a target, depth-chart or regular-season role change.
983c909d95fe01e076ee.preserved_evidence: -- With Ewers sidelined, Cam Miller again got the second-most reps at QB and he had the best throw of the day, a completion for about 20 yards in the middle of the field to Terrace Marshall Jr.

pronoun_antecedents.supporting_text: Cam Miller again got the second-most reps at QB and he had the best throw of the day

preserved_assessment.supporting_quote: With Ewers sidelined, Cam Miller again got the second-most reps at QB and he had the best throw of the day, a completion for about 20 yards in the middle of the field to Terrace Marshall Jr.
preserved_assessment.fantasy_commentary: Marshall caught one pass for approximately 20 yards from backup quarterback Cam Miller during joint practice. This is a single practice observation involving a backup quarterback, which provides minimal information about Marshall's role with the starting offense or his target distribution in game situations. The passage does not establish Marshall's depth-chart position, his work with the starting quarterback, or his expected usage in the regular season.
preserved_assessment.why_it_matters: Marshall demonstrated he can make plays when targeted, but this occurred with a backup quarterback in practice and does not indicate his standing in the regular rotation.
limitations: Single practice observation from one reporter
No information about Marshall's depth-chart position or role with starting offense
No context for overall target distribution or snap expectations
